note.overview: Many online retail channels face high rates of product returns. This poses a new challenge to the sellers’ dynamic pricing problem when some returns in good condition can be resold in the selling season. To study the impact of product returns and guide sellers in adjusting pricing policies, we build a product return model by augmenting the classic monopolist’s dynamic pricing framework.
